ModMetaData.name: Clean Pathfinding 2 - Hotpath Performance Patch
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Standalone RimWorld 1.5 performance patch for Clean Pathfinding 2. Replaces its per-cell AdjustCosts call with a direct fast implementation that prepares pawn and map state once per path, permanently disables development logging during play, and removes the older per-cell Glow Cache Optimizer detour. Clean Pathfinding remains authoritative for terrain, road, door and light behavior.
